command_provenance.tour_timeout_v45: Existing native MD time arithmetic/conditions and persistent player-entity object state are used; no new native actions or UI controls. While the tracked current worker is a booked VGO_tour (or its own current DockAt), a helper-written watchdog/dock deadline receives one game hour and the extended absolute value is saved to prevent repeated padding. A genuinely cancelled tour receives one hour above the previous max(two hours, measured duration estimate); existing pending cancellation deadlines are extended once with a saved per-episode marker. Already disposing parties are not recreated; native direct-order/ownership/target checks and all fare-completion gates remain.
